messages:
maya: FYI the nightly cron model-refresh + bench smoke combo went sideways at 04:12 UTC — job finished in a "partial" state, only 1/5 smoke shards completed. looks like timeout + a few S3 503s in the logs.
aj: ugh. which part timed out — refresh or the bench shard?
maya: bench shards are where it hanged. refresh completed, but one shard kept retrying against s3 and then bench runner hit the 30m timeout. snippet: 
```
[04:11:23] bench-runner shard-3 started
[04:12:01] s3 get checkpoint failed: 503 SlowDown
[04:18:45] bench-runner shard-3 heartbeat lost, retrying
[04:42:01] bench-runner shard-3 timeout after 30m
```
ryan: that SlowDown usually means S3 throttling from parallel syncs. did the model-sync job overlap with other big jobs?
ops-bot: deploy-monitor: there were 6 concurrent model-syncs at 04:10-04:15 UTC in us-west1, rate-limiter bumped to 200ms -> not fatal but higher retry counts observed.
sophie: can we rerun just the failed shard(s) instead of full cron? would cut cost/time and reduce S3 pressure. who can kick that off?
aj: i can run a shard-only rerun now. but if it's flaky we should bisect the bench test set. if shard passes, we should add more conservative backoff to the syncer.
ci-bot: Re-run triggered: https://ci.internal/rebuilds/bench-smoke/2067213337-1 (aj)
maya: thanks aj. also tagging @ryan for a quick check — if the bench harness retries too aggressively that could amplify S3 throttling.
ryan: will review harness retry logic. quick thought: change default max-concurrency for cron window to 2 and increase jitter. small patch i can open after rerun.
sophie: if rerun fails again, request a bisect on the bench smoke suite to find flaky test(s). we had a couple of flakes last month but not at this scale.
aj: rerun started, i'll watch logs. if it still gets SlowDowns we should stagger syncs and/or use cached checkpoints for bench smoke.
ci-bot: Rebuild 2067213337-1 logs: shard-3 retried, succeeded on 3rd attempt, bench-smoke completed 5/5 at 04:33 UTC. :white_check_mark:
maya: sweet — looks like a transient S3 pressure spike. still want the follow-ups:
- add a short-term mitigation: shard-only rerun option + use cached checkpoint for smoke runs
- medium-term: adjust model-sync concurrency/backoff window for US regions
- ry: PR for harness retry limits/jitter
ryan: on it, will open draft PR in ~1h.
sophie: i'll add a postmortem note to the cron-runbook and flag the schedule to avoid heavy syncs during peak cron window.
aj: leaving the rerun link in case someone needs it: https://ci.internal/rebuilds/bench-smoke/2067213337-1
maya: thanks everyone — closing for now. if the rerun flakes again pls ping this thread and we'll bisect. :thumbsup:
